How the answers are independently verified

A seeded generator records the intended assembly, renders a PNG, and computes the answer from the geometry, inventory, pattern, rotations, or graph. A separate program reopens the exported PNG and measures the visible marks. The dataset accepts an image when both answers agree, the restyled panel preserves the answer, and the single edit changes it.

These are synthetic top-view diagrams. Production photographs, glare, occlusion, and electrical performance require separate validation.
